title: The Jackdaw and the Pigeons
summary: A jackdaw whitewashed his feathers and joined a dove-cote to enjoy free grain. All went well until he forgot himself and uttered a harsh jackdaw caw....
full_text:
A jackdaw whitewashed his feathers and joined a dove-cote to enjoy free grain. All went well until he forgot himself and uttered a harsh jackdaw caw.

The pigeons drove him out with their beaks. Returning to his own flock, the jackdaws rejected his white feathers, leaving him outcast by all.
moral: Counterfeit appearances lose both new allies and former friends.
